Digitised for the Digital Library of India; hosted by the Internet Archive. Item: Dialogues Of The Buddha,pt.1 · Rhys Davids,t.w.,tr · 1899, 366 scanned pages. Published 1899; Thomas William Rhys Davids died 1922; public domain in India.

This book is not stored in this library: its pages are shown from the Internet Archive when they are opened, in this library's own viewer, and each chapter ends with this credit.
